tagging_basis: AQA 7037 specification codes; AS units mapped to the matching A-level leaf

units.summary: Outline the role of one or more institutions in regulating global systems.
units.difficulty_basis: 4-mark AO1 outline of familiar governance content; any institution accepted.

units.summary: Analyse a divided bar graph of workforce skills and a scatter graph of GDP and literacy in south-east Asia.
units.difficulty_basis: 6-mark AO3 analysis of two quantitative graphs with linked variables.

units.summary: Using a figure on China and Sub-Saharan Africa trade, assess trading relationships between emerging major economies and smaller less developed ones.
units.difficulty_basis: 6-mark AO1/AO2 short assess applying trade knowledge to a novel figure.

units.summary: Critically assess whether global governance of the global commons directly affects the student and people worldwide.
units.difficulty_basis: 20-mark essay requiring commons concept, governance consequences and a personal-to-global evaluative judgement.

units.summary: Outline how a qualitative source was used to investigate past lived experience in the student's local place.
units.difficulty_basis: 4-mark AO1 outline of a method applied to a place study; limited depth.

units.summary: Interpret maps of no-education population share and the Index of Multiple Deprivation in the Falmouth area.
units.difficulty_basis: 6-mark AO3 interpretation of two choropleth maps, connecting patterns.

units.summary: Using before and after photographs and own knowledge, judge how shifting investment flows change a place's characteristics.
units.difficulty_basis: 6-mark AO1/AO2 short extent evaluation applying knowledge to novel paired images.

units.summary: Assess the role of endogenous factors in shaping lived experience in the local or distant place studied.
units.difficulty_basis: 20-mark essay needing a place study and evaluation of one factor group against lived experience.

units.summary: Outline how urban form affects local weather and climate.
units.difficulty_basis: 4-mark AO1 outline of familiar urban climate content.

units.summary: Analyse PM2.5 air pollution data for European cities from two or more figures.
units.difficulty_basis: 6-mark AO3 analysis of quantitative pollution data with comparisons across cities.

units.summary: Using two photographs, assess the extent to which La Defense shows edge city characteristics.
units.difficulty_basis: 9-mark extent item (AO1 4 AO2 5) applying new urban landscape knowledge to novel images.

units.summary: Evaluate sustainable urban drainage systems as a way to manage water movement through urban catchments.
units.difficulty_basis: 9-mark evaluate item requiring knowledge of catchment hydrology and strategy appraisal.

units.summary: Assess whether British urban regeneration since 1979 has come to feature more dimensions of sustainability.
units.difficulty_basis: 20-mark essay tracing policy change over time and judging it against sustainability dimensions.

units.summary: Outline the concept of the ecological footprint.
units.difficulty_basis: 4-mark AO1 outline of a named concept; familiar content.

units.summary: Analyse fertility data for European Union countries.
units.difficulty_basis: 6-mark AO3 analysis of quantitative fertility measures, patterns and changes.

units.summary: Using a figure on UK lung cancer and smoking, evaluate the success of strategies to reduce non-communicable disease.
units.difficulty_basis: 9-mark evaluate item (AO1 4 AO2 5) applying mitigation knowledge to a novel time series.

units.summary: Assess whether some agricultural soil problems are easier to manage than others.
units.difficulty_basis: 9-mark extent item comparing several soil problems and management responses.

units.summary: With a case study of a country experiencing population change, assess environmental versus socio-economic factors in demographic transition.
units.difficulty_basis: 20-mark essay requiring a country case study and a comparative evaluation of factor groups.

units.summary: Outline global patterns of water availability.
units.difficulty_basis: 4-mark AO1 outline of familiar global pattern; exemplification credited.

units.summary: Analyse global variation in solar power capacity by world region.
units.difficulty_basis: 6-mark AO3 analysis of a regional quantitative data figure.

units.summary: Assess the extent to which physical geography explains energy mixes in contrasting areas studied.
units.difficulty_basis: 9-mark extent item needing two contrasting areas and evaluation of physical versus other controls.

units.summary: Assess whether technology and development make mineral and energy resources effectively infinite.
units.difficulty_basis: 20-mark essay on resource futures across energy and mineral ores with evaluative judgement.
